label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Porque sus altares demolerán, y sus estelas quebrarán, y sus asherás cortarán.
spanish: Porque sus altares demolerán, y sus pilares quebrarán, y su Asera cortarán.
grammarChanges: Changed 'sus asherás' (plural, lowercase common-noun transliteration) to singular proper noun 'su Asera', matching the 3ms suffix on h02034013009.
Changed the third 'sus' to 'su' to mark the suffix shift from 3mp (h02034013003, h02034013006) to 3ms (h02034013009); repeated 'sus' had erased that change.
Changed 'estelas' to 'pilares' for h02034013006 (H4676) to keep the broader standing-pillar/stone sense instead of narrowing to an inscribed stele.
readerNote: Chose singular 'su Asera' and 'su' for the 3ms suffix (h02034013009) against the preceding 3mp 'sus' (h02034013003, h02034013006); chose 'pilares' over 'estelas' for H4676's broader pillar/stone sense.
